description: OMENZ Checkpoint (create): split an agent job into paid milestones. Each milestone has an amount, its own deterministic acceptance tests (required_fields, field_types, regex, min_items, max_bytes, equals, url_alive, claim_evidence) and an optional deadline. Returns a signed plan and checkpoint_id. OMENZ never holds funds. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/checkpoint/create, $0.005 via x402.)
